ig_caption:
Mon, Nov 16: 23,445 deer reported statewide (16,673 antlered, 6,772 antlerless). Season total: 149,599.

Monday added 23,445 reports, nearly matching Sunday's 23,507, but the antlered share slipped from 74% to 71%. Hillsdale added 558 deer, 39% of them antlerless, among the most antlerless-leaning counties of the day.
